news.headline: Lexeo to present at Cantor and Baird healthcare conferences in September
news.summary: Management will hold a fireside chat at the Cantor Global Healthcare Conference 2026 on September 9 at 2:10 p.m. ET and at the Baird 2026 Global Healthcare Conference on September 15 at 11:25 a.m. ET, both in New York and webcast live. These remain the only scheduled company events between the August 12 Q2 print and the Q4 LX2020 twelve-month data update.

news.headline: 13F season shows Jupiter Topco taking a new 3.95M-share position in Lexeo
news.summary: Jupiter Topco LLC opened a new stake of 3,954,691 shares worth roughly $18.4 million during Q2, while Affinity Asset Advisors held 5.05 million shares ($29.0M), OrbiMed 3.60 million ($20.7M) and Dimensional 1.10 million ($6.3M). Institutional investors now own about 60.7% of Lexeo, with the stock near $4.89 and a market cap of roughly $401 million against a 52-week range of $3.99 to $10.99.

news.headline: CEO Townsend and CFO file Form 4s for tax-withholding sales after RSU release
news.summary: CEO R. Nolan Townsend sold 3,345 shares on August 18 at a weighted average $4.9512 (trades between $4.83 and $5.01) purely to cover taxes on a restricted stock unit release, leaving him with 374,472 shares held directly. The CFO filed an equivalent small tax-withholding sale, so this is routine compensation mechanics rather than a discretionary reduction of insider exposure.

news.headline: Institutional cluster discloses 5%+ stakes in Lexeo after RMAT and Q2 news
news.summary: Balyasny Asset Management disclosed 7.84 million shares, or 9.99% including 5.43 million shares issuable from warrants under a 9.99% blocker, while Paradigm BioCapital reported 5.3% (4.2M shares), OrbiMed a combined 5.0% and Affinity Asset Advisors 8.4% (6.7M shares); State Street had disclosed 5.5% on August 7. The wave of Schedule 13G filings around the LX2020 RMAT designation and the Q2 print points to broad institutional accumulation in the cardiac gene therapy story.

news.headline: RBC Capital keeps Outperform on Lexeo, trims price target to $20
news.summary: RBC Capital reiterated its Outperform rating while cutting its price target to $20 from $24 after Q2 results, pointing to the clean tolerability profile of Lexeo's AAV cardiac programs. Nine covering analysts now sit at a median 12-month target of roughly $18.44 against a share price near $4.89, with the low end at $9 (JPMorgan, cut from $12 on June 15) and the high end at $30.

news.headline: Lexeo reports Q2 2026: $234.2M cash into 2028, SUNRISE-FA 2 enrolling
news.summary: Lexeo posted a Q2 net loss of $25.9 million, or $(0.30) per share (R&D $19.0M vs $14.7M a year ago, G&A $9.0M vs $16.0M), and ended June with $234.2 million in cash, cash equivalents and investments, guided to fund operations into 2028. CEO Nolan Townsend flagged the initiation of pivotal SUNRISE-FA 2 for LX2006, with the first site activated and first patient enrolled in June, keeping topline data on track for 2H 2027 and a potential BLA in 1H 2028.

catalysts.label: Cantor and Baird conference fireside chats
catalysts.detail: Management fireside chat at the Cantor Global Healthcare Conference on September 9 at 2:10 p.m. ET, followed by the Baird Global Healthcare Conference on September 15 at 11:25 a.m. ET, both webcast from the Events and Presentations tab of the IR site. These are the nearest opportunities for management to add colour on SUNRISE-FA 2 enrollment pace, the LX2020 registrational design under RMAT, and the timing of the Q4 twelve-month PKP2 readout. No new data is expected, but tone and any tightening of the Q4 window matter for a stock trading near its 52-week low.

catalysts.label: LX2020 12-month high-dose HEROIC-PKP2 data
catalysts.detail: Twelve-month efficacy and safety update from all high-dose participants in the Phase I/II HEROIC-PKP2 trial in PKP2-associated arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy, explicitly guided for Q4 2026 and reconfirmed in the Q2 report. LX2020 has been generally well tolerated across ten dosed participants with no clinically significant complement activation to date. A clean 12-month readout showing durable PKP2 protein restoration and sustained arrhythmia-burden reduction would support moving into a registrational study under the new RMAT designation. This is the single nearest hard datapoint for the stock.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly results with SUNRISE-FA 2 enrollment pace, site-activation progress and updated cash-runway commentary against the $234.2 million balance. Based on the prior cadence after the August 12 Q2 report, the date should fall in early-to-mid November 2026; the company has not yet confirmed it. Any change to the into-2028 runway guidance would be the key financial signal, and the print may double as the venue for the Q4 LX2020 update.

catalysts.label: FDA engagement on LX2020 registrational path
catalysts.detail: Lexeo listed FDA regulatory engagement for LX2020 among its anticipated 2026 milestones in the Q2 report, now that RMAT is in hand and allows earlier and more frequent meetings on clinical, manufacturing and regulatory plans. The output investors want is a defined registrational trial design with agreed endpoints for PKP2-ACM, which would convert the Phase I/II signal into a path to approval in a US population of roughly 60,000 patients with no disease-modifying therapy. Timing of any public update has not been specified.

catalysts.label: SUNRISE-FA 2 topline data (LX2006)
catalysts.detail: Pivotal open-label readout in Friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy comparing roughly 13 LX2006-treated adults at the high dose against an untreated control group, with left ventricular mass index and frataxin expression as the FDA-aligned key endpoints and the CLARITY-FA natural history study supplying untreated-course comparison. The protocol and statistical analysis plan were finalized in June 2026 and the first patient was dosed that same month. LX2006 already holds Breakthrough Therapy, RMAT, Orphan Drug and Fast Track designations and sits in the FDA CMC Development and Readiness Pilot.

catalysts.label: LX2006 BLA submission (accelerated approval)
catalysts.detail: Targeted Biologics License Application to the FDA under the accelerated-approval pathway based on SUNRISE-FA 2 evidence, per the regulatory alignment announced on June 15, 2026. The FDA has confirmed no additional nonclinical bridging studies are required and that the optimized Sf9-baculovirus commercial-scale process can be used for pivotal dosing. Submission remains contingent on a positive 2H 2027 readout, so this is a target rather than a fixed date.

pulse: Nothing new has come out of Lexeo since the September 2 conference announcement, so the setup is unchanged: the August 5 RMAT designation for LX2020 in PKP2 cardiomyopathy sits on top of June's pivotal-trial alignment for LX2006, and the August 12 Q2 print confirmed SUNRISE-FA 2 is enrolling with $234.2 million in cash funding operations into 2028. The shares still sit around $4.89 for a market cap near $401 million, close to the $3.99 low of the 52-week range and far below the roughly $18 median target from nine covering analysts, even as institutions kept accumulating (Balyasny 9.99% including warrants, Affinity 8.4%, State Street 5.5%, Paradigm 5.3%, OrbiMed 5.0%, about 60.7% institutional ownership). The immediate thing to watch is the September 9 Cantor and September 15 Baird fireside chats for any tightening of guidance, then the Q4 2026 twelve-month high-dose PKP2 readout, which is the last hard catalyst before the wait stretches to 2H 2027 pivotal LX2006 data.
